About the Role
 
We are looking for a data scientist intern to join our Data Science team at GoPay - you will create models which help grow the customer base and transactions in GoPay. You will work closely with the business, product and engineering stakeholders to identify and solve some of the most challenging business problems in the payments space. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment in a highly cross-functional team and leverage our robust data infrastructure

description:
About the Role

This CRM Executive role sits at the center of how Gojek SG communicates with riders and drivers, owning end-to-end execution of push, email, and in-app campaigns across both audiences. This role was restructured to combine the roles of both rider and driver comms to become the primary owner of CRM execution for both sides, working closely with the Mercury platform team on tooling and with Marketing on campaign strategy. In the first six months,

lists.content:
• Set up and launch push notification, email, and other in-app campaigns for rider and driver audiences
  • Build and maintain audience segments, triggers, and lifecycle journeys for acquisition, retention, and resurrection
  • Facilitate targeting logic, comms copies and send schedules with the marketing team
  • Run A/B and multivariate tests on messaging, timing and audiences
  • Monitor daily campaign performance, analyse results, and flag issues quickly

• 2–3 years of experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a consumer app, marketplace, or on-demand business
  • Hands-on experience with a CRM or engagement platform (e.g. Braze, CleverTap, MoEngage, or an in-house tool)
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and basic SQL
  • Experience with A/B testing and interpreting results with statistical rigour
